casual.scene: Inside an empty observatory visitor gallery beside an open terrace window on a clear blue evening. She stands comfortably behind a waist-high wooden ledge, torso only 15 degrees from front-facing, both shoulders and collarbones visible. Her head stays aligned with her chest with at most a gentle 10-degree turn, eyes looking toward camera, never looking back over a shoulder. One complete hand rests open on the front edge of the ledge, the other carefully places a small plain orange glass sun-catching ornament on a simple stand farther along the ledge; hands separated and visible. Distant stars, telescope silhouette and warm amber gallery lamps, no other people.
